item.title: Transforming EPE Pearl Cotton Waste into Sustainable Resources
item.description:
Transforming EPE Pearl Cotton Waste into Sustainable Resources
#

EPE pearl cotton is a popular material in packaging due to its lightweight, shock-absorbing, and moisture-resistant qualities. Despite its widespread use, questions often arise about its fate after disposal. While EPE is not biodegradable, it is highly recyclable. With the right processes and equipment, manufacturers can reduce both production costs and environmental impact, turning waste into valuable resources and supporting a more sustainable production cycle.

item.title: Efficient Solutions for Rigid Plastic Flake Re-Pelletizing
item.description:
Efficient Solutions for Rigid Plastic Flake Re-Pelletizing
#

Recycling rigid plastic scraps, such as HDPE milk bottles, shampoo bottles, and PP/PE lumps from extruder die heads, requires a systematic approach to ensure high-quality re-pelletizing. The process begins with reducing the size of the plastic scrap to suitable feeding dimensions, which is essential for efficient downstream processing.
